message:
The other day, I was rummaging through some old boxes in the attic and came across our family board games. It struck me how much joy they brought us—laughter, friendly competition, and memories that I cherish. In this digital age, it’s easy to forget about the simple pleasures that keep us connected. 

As I dusted off those games, I thought about how important it is to have a plan for emergencies but also to remember to enjoy the little things. Maybe a family board game night could be a nice way to gather everyone, talk about what we’d do in an emergency, and just connect. 

Have you rediscovered any low-tech fun lately?
